 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Restore cells obscured by color 2 using the grid's dihedral symmetry."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(grid)
    if any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("Expected a square grid")
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if grid[r][c] != 2:
                continue
            orbit = (
                (r, c),
                (r, n - 1 - c),
                (n - 1 - r, c),
                (n - 1 - r, n - 1 - c),
                (c, r),
                (c, n - 1 - r),
                (n - 1 - c, r),
                (n - 1 - c, n - 1 - r),
            )
            values = [grid[y][x] for y, x in orbit if grid[y][x] != 2]
            if not values:
                raise ValueError(f"No visible symmetric source for {(r, c)}")
            # The source pattern is invariant under these reflections/diagonal
            # symmetries; use the first unoccluded member of the orbit.
            out[r][c] = values[0]
    return out
